systemTitle.help: The title of the system under study: name or short description of the object of analysis that sits in the middle row in the present. Free text; an empty text clears the field.

colLabels.help: The three labels of the time axis, in the order past, present, future. An empty entry means the column shows its default. There are always exactly three entries.

rowLabels.help: The three labels of the system levels, in the order subsystem, system, supersystem. An empty entry means the row shows its default. There are always exactly three entries.

cells.help: The nine windows, one for each system level (row: subsystem, system, supersystem) and each time window (column: past, present, future). Every window carries a free text and at most one image, such as a sketch. The image data appears only as a size. The grid comes in full only on request; otherwise only its extent appears.

setCellText.help: Writes the text of a window, like typing into the window's text field in the interface. An image in the window stays.

params.row: The system level, 0 to 2: subsystem, system, supersystem. Any other value is rejected.
params.col: The time window, 0 to 2: past, present, future. Any other value is rejected.
params.text: The new text of the window; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with row, col and text.

clearImage.help: Removes the image of a window, in the interface via the round button at the top right of the thumbnail. The window's text stays.

params.row: The system level, 0 to 2: subsystem, system, supersystem. Any other value is rejected.
params.col: The time window, 0 to 2: past, present, future. Any other value is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with row and col.

setCellImage.help: Sets the image of a window, replacing an existing one, only through the interface: via the window's image button or by dropping an image file onto it. The window's text stays.

params.row: The system level, 0 to 2: subsystem, system, supersystem. Any other value is rejected.
params.col: The time window, 0 to 2: past, present, future. Any other value is rejected.
params.dataUrl: The image as a data URL.
params.command: The command as an object with row, col and dataUrl.
